scope: HX50 real-read recovery; unchanged recruitment/refiltering reused. ppect is another species, not same-individual truth. Coverage is a union of coding evidence, not a complete CDS or validated copy. No biological false-merge rate is measurable.

panel.selection: first 12 by long intron count, maximum intron length, family ID; CDS 300–4500 nt and >=3 exons

previous_miniprot.wrong_merge_rate_reason: No same-individual genome or validated linkage truth for HX50; ambiguity rejection is not a measured false-merge rate.

serial_parallel_miniprot.scope: 8 candidate workers, each single-threaded, versus one worker. Read-root path excluded from audit comparison. Commands/execution metadata intentionally differ.

direct_refiltered_read_diagnostic.scope: Direct miniprot alignment of refiltered HX50 reads to ppect protein. A diagnostic union, not proof of sequence accuracy, completeness of one copy, or linkage; no CDS reconstruction from read alignments.
